Copy of a birth certificate

A certified copy of a birth certificate registered in Tarnmose can be requested online from the Tarnmose Civil Records Office.

Fee
€16.90 per certified copy
Processing time
7 working days
Issuing office
Tarnmose Civil Records Office
Who may request one
Only persons listed in the municipal population register of Tarnmose, and their legal representatives
Document to present
a valid national photo ID (identity card or passport)

Fee

A certified copy of a birth certificate costs €16.90 per copy. The fee is payable when the application is submitted.

Processing time

Applications are processed within 7 working days of receipt. Copies are sent to the applicant's registered address by post.

Issuing office

Certified copies are issued by the Tarnmose Civil Records Office.

Who may request one

Only persons listed in the municipal population register of Tarnmose, and their legal representatives may request a certified copy.

What to present

Applicants must present a valid national photo ID (identity card or passport).

How to apply

Applications are made online. Have your identity document ready before you begin.
